thread:
maria_ae: Heads-up — MerchantX (regulated payments) wants to start a POC but their legal/security checklist requires: SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning with delta sync, RBAC at role level, and domain verification/ownership before any production keys. They also asked about encryption of assertions and audit logs. Can sales-eng confirm if any of this blocks the POC?
sam_saleseng: Short answer: not blocking. We support SAML 2.0 and SCIM v2. Need to clarify a couple of deployment details (hosted vs private) for audit/keys + whether they need dedicated capacity for SLAs. Will loop in solutions for exact scoping.
elaine_solutions: Happy to drive. Quick checklist from our side:
- Domain ownership: we support DNS TXT or CNAME verification (can verify multiple domains under one org).
- SAML: SP metadata + signed assertions; both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows supported.
- SCIM: /Users provisioning, supports bulk create/update/delete and incremental delta using the "startIndex"/"operations" pattern.
- RBAC: we have role templates (admin, developer, viewer) and can add custom roles scoped to org or project.
- Audit: event stream available in Console + can export to customer S3 or SIEM via webhook/CloudTrail integration on Private.
elaine_solutions: For the POC I recommend this plan:
1) MerchantX provides test IdP metadata (SAML) and a set of test accounts.
2) We'll do a short domain verify (DNS TXT) for their primary domain.
3) Configure SCIM with OAuth2 token (short-lived) for the POC; for production they can switch to client-cert or mTLS on Private.
4) Map SCIM groups to our role templates and show RBAC flows.
frank_security: A few security Qs/notes from SGTM side:
- SAML: we support signed AuthnRequests and encrypted assertions. We sign responses with our org cert (rotated quarterly by default, can align with customer on Dedicated/Private).
- SCIM: TLS 1.2+ required, we recommend OAuth2 Bearer tokens with rotation. For customers wanting mTLS, that's supported on Private nodes.
- Audit logs: retention defaults 90d on Hosted; we can extend for Dedicated/Private. We can provide a signed attestation for retention policy on request.
- Data residency: if they require EU-only storage we need to know now (affects POC infra).
maria_ae: They asked specifically whether we support SCIM delta sync (i.e., only sending changed users) because they have a large tenant with 40k users.
elaine_solutions: We do support incremental SCIM using the "If-None-Match" ETag pattern on list endpoints and PATCH operations per RFC7644. For very large orgs we recommend an initial bulk sync (a single push) followed by deltas. Example curl for POC token-based SCIM:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SCIM_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.prod/scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100
```
elaine_solutions: Sample SAML metadata we can provide (they asked what fields we need):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-inference.prod/saml" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true" protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient</NameIDFormat>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood-inference.prod/saml/acs" index="1"/>
    <SingleLogoutService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://redwood-inference.prod/saml/slo"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
frank_security: Good — also flagging that MerchantX asked for crypto details: we use AES-256 for at-rest keys, HSM options available for Private, and transport uses TLS 1.2+/1.3. We'll provide a short secops package (CSP, cert fingerprints, rotation policy) — just need their info classification to tailor it.
jess_account: On pricing: POC is complimentary for 30 days with limited concurrent sessions. If they want Dedicated for the POC (to mirror enterprise SLAs), that runs as a short-term reserved capacity with pro-rated monthly commit — I can surface numbers once we know expected peak qps and sequence lengths.
maria_ae: They also asked about domain whitelisting (only allow SSO from verified domains) and tenant-scoped subdomains. Do we have a way to block signups from unverified orgs?
elaine_solutions: Yes — we can enforce domain allowlist at org creation and block self-serve signups until domain verification is complete. For tenant subdomains we support customer-owned DNS and can host subdomains on Private. For hosted accounts we can route via our CDN once TXT verification passes.
sam_saleseng: Next steps for us:
- Maria: request IdP metadata + SCIM token for test account; confirm data residency (EU vs US).
- Elaine: prepare scoping doc and short SSO/SCIM runbook to attach to the POC ticket.
- Frank: prepare secops package and confirm audit retention options.
- Jess: rough Dedicated vs Hosted pricing ranges based on qps (will DM merchant to get numbers).
deploy-bot: test-env/redwood-merchantx-scim deployed — URL: https://staging.redwood-inference.prod/merchantx (SCIM endpoints and SAML ACS configured for test metadata). :rocket:
maria_ae: Perfect — I'll ask MerchantX for the metadata + sample user CSV and push timeline this afternoon. Will update here when they send it. :thumbsup:
